title: PDF export times out on large reports
symptom: Export to PDF spins for ~60s then fails on reports with more than ~5,000 rows. CSV export works.
root_cause: New PDF rendering engine introduced in 4.2.1 loads the full dataset into memory before rendering
workaround: Export as CSV instead or split the report into smaller date ranges (under 5k rows each)

title: Okta SSO users logged out every 15 minutes
symptom: Users signing in via Okta SAML are forced to re-authenticate every 15 minutes, even while active.
error_message: Session expired. Please sign in again.
root_cause: SAML session TTL set to 15 min instead of 8 hrs in 4.2.0 session management changes
workaround: Tick 'Keep me signed in' on the login page; fix scheduled for 4.2.4

title: Widgets show stale data after user changes timezone
symptom: After changing timezone in profile, dashboard widgets keep showing data for the old timezone until cache expires (~1 hr).
root_cause: Widget cache key does not include user timezone (4.2.1 timezone feature)
workaround: Hard refresh the browser (Ctrl+Shift+R) or log out and back in

title: Duplicate email alerts for approval requests
symptom: Approvers receive the same approval email 2-3 times within a minute.
root_cause: Retry logic in email worker did not check delivery status

title: Search returns no results for hyphenated terms
symptom: Searching for terms like 'e-invoice' or 'follow-up' returns zero results, even when matching records exist.
root_cause: Tokenizer splits on hyphens but query parser does not
workaround: Wrap the term in double quotes or search without the hyphen

title: Dark mode toggle label overlaps on narrow screens
symptom: On screens under 400px wide, the 'Dark mode' label overlaps the toggle switch in Settings > Appearance.

title: iOS app crashes when opening large attachments
symptom: The iOS app closes immediately when a user opens an attachment larger than 20MB.
root_cause: In-app previewer loads entire file into memory
workaround: Open the attachment from the web app or download via the share sheet

title: Refund confirmation email not sent
symptom: Customers receive refunds but no confirmation email is sent.
root_cause: Email template ID missing for refund event

title: Scheduled reports send empty CSV on weekends
symptom: Reports scheduled for Saturday or Sunday arrive as empty CSV files.
root_cause: Scheduler used business-day calendar for data range

title: Password reset link expires immediately
symptom: Users clicking the password reset link from Outlook see 'Link expired' right away.
error_message: This link has expired. Please request a new one.
root_cause: Outlook Safe Links pre-fetches the URL and consumes the one-time token
workaround: Copy the link and paste it directly into the browser instead of clicking

title: Card payments declined for 3-decimal currencies
symptom: Payments in KWD, BHD, or OMR are declined at checkout. Other currencies work.
error_message: Payment declined: invalid amount format (code PAY-422)
root_cause: Amount formatter rounds to 2 decimals before sending to gateway
workaround: Process the payment manually via the finance team

title: Chart export to PNG is blank in Firefox
symptom: Exporting a dashboard chart as PNG produces a blank white image in Firefox only.

title: Jira sync fails for project keys containing digits
symptom: Jira integration stops syncing for projects whose key contains a number (e.g. 'OPS2').
root_cause: Project key validation regex only allows letters
workaround: Rename the Jira project key or use manual export

title: Search is slow for admins with many workspaces
symptom: Admin users with more than 50 workspaces see search take more than 10 seconds.
root_cause: Search queries every workspace index sequentially
workaround: Filter search by workspace before searching

title: Slack notifications delayed up to 30 minutes
symptom: Slack alerts arrive 10-30 minutes after the event.
